title: Fill in the Blanks
description: Complete each sentence with the correct word from the box.

questions.text: The online bookstore packs every textbook parcel into a sturdy __________ before shipping.
Fallen maple leaves and organic fruit cores take several weeks to __________ under warm, damp soil.
Before leaving for soccer training, Minh always fills his stainless steel __________ with cold water.
You should thoroughly __________ empty juice cartons before placing them into the recycling bin.
Sanitation regulations instruct residents to __________ into distinct organic and dry rubbish bins.
Instead of taking a single-use plastic straw for her smoothie, Lan sips through a washable __________.
Adding discarded orange rind and apple __________ to the compost bin enriches garden soil naturally.
Grandpa built a wooden __________ and hung it on the oak branch so local birds can feed in winter.
We painted an old tin can and turned it into a charming __________ for fresh green basil.
Disposing of plastic rings and fishing nets near natural rivers can seriously __________.
